item.title: Dubai Healthcare City Authority to begin AED 1.3 billion expansion project in December 2025
item.description: Dubai Healthcare City Authority is launching a AED 1.3 billion expansion for Phase 1, aiming to solidify Dubai as a global healthcare innovation hub. The project includes the UAE's first LEED Platinum office building and a new medical complex, with construction commencing in December 2025 and completion by November 2027.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: GITEX 2025: Dubai Ruler Sheikh Mohammed inaugurates world’s largest tech and AI event
item.description: GITEX Global 2025, inaugurated by Sheikh Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum in Dubai, marks its 45th edition with record-breaking global participation. Hosting over 6,800 companies and 2,000 startups, the event highlights the UAE’s push for AI-driven innovation, digital economy growth, and global tech leadership—aligned with national strategies like D33, UAE Vision 2031, and Dubai’s AED100 billion transformation goal.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: “Stefon Diggs gives Cardi five rounds a night”: Rebecca J fires back at Offset after he accused her in his DMs
item.description: Rapper Offset faced backlash after implying Instagram model Rebecca J pursued him. Rebecca J responded strongly, calling Offset's actions embarrassing and defending Cardi B. She praised Cardi as self-made and referenced NFL player Stefon Diggs in a viral comment. The internet reacted to Rebecca J's defense and sharp retort, highlighting her confidence and willingness to respond.
item.dc:creator: Amisha Pandey

item.title: Dubai Global Village 2025: Everything you need to know about tickets, attractions, and insider tips
item.description: Dubai Global Village launches its 30th season on October 15, 2025, running until May 10, 2026, with extended hours and budget-friendly tickets. This year features new attractions like "Gardens of the World" and "The Dragon Kingdom," alongside visual upgrades and expanded dining options. Public transport and parking are readily available for visitors.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: How to reach Dubai Global Village 2025: Timings, public and private transport guide for easy access
item.description: Dubai Global Village's 30th season opens October 15, 2025, running until May 10, 2026. Visitors can easily reach the popular destination via dedicated RTA bus routes, metro connections with short bus/taxi transfers, or by private vehicle with ample parking. Taxi and ride-hailing services also offer convenient door-to-door access.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: UAE: Abu Dhabi unveils AI tools for early detection of diabetes, cancer and other chronic diseases
item.description: Abu Dhabi is pioneering AI-driven healthcare, launching initiatives like the Next-Gen Wellness program to predict and prevent chronic diseases. These advancements, including a comprehensive patient risk profiling system and the Malaffi health information exchange, shift healthcare towards a proactive, personalized model, enhancing physician capabilities and promoting longer, healthier lives for residents.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: 'Love was never about...': Amid Trudeau-Katy Perry dating rumours, ex-wife Sophie Grégoire shares 'letting go' Instagram post
item.description: Sophie Grégoire, ex-wife of Justin Trudeau, shared a reflective Instagram post about letting go and the nature of love, following photos of Trudeau with Katy Perry. Grégoire emphasized that love is about presence, not possession, and that releasing what cannot be kept makes space for deeper connection and lessons learned.

item.title: Who is Miriam Adelson? Trump praises mega-donor's influence on US policy towards Israel
item.description: During a speech to Israel's parliament, President Trump highlighted mega-donor Miriam Adelson's significant influence on US policy towards Israel. He credited her and her late husband, Sheldon Adelson, with shaping key decisions, including the recognition of Jerusalem as Israel's capital and the embassy move. Trump emphasised their extraordinary access and impact on his administration.

item.title: 'You don’t mind right?': Trump calls Meloni 'beautiful young woman' in Gaza peace summit - Watch
item.description: At the Gaza Peace Summit, US President Donald Trump complimented Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni's appearance, calling her a "beautiful young woman." He then praised her political success and effectiveness.

item.title: 'A lot of cash. Unlimited cash': Trump's funny interaction with UAE sheikh goes viral — Watch
item.description: US President Donald Trump's humorous remark about "unlimited cash" from a UAE official went viral during a photo op in Sharm el-Sheikh. item.title: 'You look great, but stop smoking!': Erdogan tells Meloni at peace talks — Here's what Italian PM replied
item.description: Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan playfully urged Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni to quit smoking during a peace summit in Egypt. Despite French President Macron's skepticism, Erdogan reiterated Turkey's commitment to a smoke-free future, even on the sidelines of international diplomacy.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Has the Nobel Peace Prize become a trophy only for Western ideology? A look at history of past awardees
item.description: Venezuelan opposition leader María Corina Machado has been awarded the 2025 Nobel Peace Prize for her push for democratic change. The committee cited her unifying role and advocacy for free elections. However, her pro-US foreign policy stances and ties to Israel's Likud party have ignited debate, with critics questioning the award's geopolitical implications and historical precedents.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Gaza deal: Nepal’s Bipin Joshi still missing as families reunite under truce — how did the sole Hindu hostage go missing?
item.description: While hostages return, Nepal's Joshi family endures agonizing wait for son Bipin, abducted by Hamas. Despite hopes, his name isn't on released lists. Bipin, a farming student, bravely deflected a grenade during the attack. His family's desperate pleas and efforts continue, seeking his safe return amidst profound uncertainty.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: ‘This took 3,000 years': Trump signs Gaza peace deal in Egypt summit
item.description: US President Donald Trump and regional leaders signed a landmark Gaza peace deal in Egypt, hailed as a historic step toward regional stability. The comprehensive agreement formalizes frameworks for ceasefire implementation, humanitarian assistance, and longer-term peace talks between Israel and Palestinian authorities. The summit, co-chaired by Trump and Egyptian President El-Sisi, saw participation from numerous world leaders.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Green card holder Paramjit Singh still in ICE custody, family says second brain tumor surgery delayed due to detention
item.description: Paramjit Singh, a 48-year-old with a green card and a business in Indiana, who was detained by the ICE at Chicago airport when he returned from India, is still in detention. His family hired a private investigator to prob the 2008 forgery offence that immigration authorities cited after citing a 1999 pay phone case. The investigator found no active case against Singh, his family said.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Anita Anand’s legacy: How Canada’s first Indian-origin foreign minister shaped bilateral ties – ups and downs
item.description: Canada's Foreign Minister Anita Anand is actively working to mend ties with India following a period of strained relations. Her recent visit to India emphasized a commitment to strengthening cooperation in trade, technology, and climate action, aiming for a more constructive partnership.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: ‘She loves Israel so much…’: What Trump said about daughter Ivanka and her conversion to Judaism in Knesset speech — watch
item.description: President Trump lauded his daughter Ivanka Trump's love for Israel and her conversion to Judaism during a speech at the Knesset. He highlighted her personal journey and happiness following her marriage to Jared Kushner, who also played a role in peace efforts. Trump celebrated the Gaza ceasefire as an end to a "long nightmare" for the region.
